name: Spherical Volume Voxel Traversal
definition: A spherical coordinate voxel traversal algorithm that traces a ray with unit direction over a spherical voxel grid, returning a vector of the spherical coordinate voxels traversed.
summary: Spherical Volume Voxel Traversal is a ray-marching algorithm that efficiently samples volumetric data on spherical domains by traversing spherical shells, cones, and wedges to avoid Cartesian distortion.
